# Fynix Digital

> A specialized digital growth studio for cybersecurity, tech-product, and SaaS companies — integrating UI/UX design, custom web development, technical SEO / Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and B2B lead generation into one accountable growth pipeline.

Fynix Digital builds high-performance digital growth systems for growing B2B companies. UI/UX, engineering, AI-ready SEO, and lead generation are delivered as one pipeline, with Core Web Vitals (LCP under 2.5s) and measurable revenue impact treated as hard quality gates. Studio based in London and Bengaluru.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://fynix.digital/services): All four growth capabilities delivered as one integrated pipeline.
- [UI/UX Design](https://fynix.digital/services/ui-ux): Buyer research, information architecture, high-fidelity design systems, and conversion rate optimisation for enterprise B2B software buyers.
- [Custom Development](https://fynix.digital/services/development): Headless web applications on Next.js, React, and TypeScript, with Core Web Vitals as a hard quality gate.
- [SEO & Answer Engine Optimisation](https://fynix.digital/services/seo): Technical SEO, Schema.org structured data, and optimisation for AI answer engines such as ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google Gemini.
- [B2B Lead Generation](https://fynix.digital/services/lead-generation): ICP research, multi-channel outbound sequences, landing pages, and revenue attribution.

## Case Studies

- [Case studies overview](https://fynix.digital/case-studies): Measurable outcomes across cybersecurity and B2B software.
- [Eventus Security](https://fynix.digital/case-studies/eventus): AI-powered threat detection and security platform (Cybersecurity, SOC & Managed Security).
- [CleanStart](https://fynix.digital/case-studies/cleanstart): Hardened, secure container images built for speed (SaaS Product).
- [PhotonMatters](https://fynix.digital/case-studies/photonmatters): Advanced automation technology, translated for humans (Automation, Deep-Tech).
- [Alsonotify](https://fynix.digital/case-studies/alsonotify): SaaS project management with clearer product communication (SaaS, Project Management).
- [Payweek](https://fynix.digital/case-studies/payweek): Payroll made intuitive for employees and powerful for HR (Fintech, HR & Payroll).
